payload.summary: PR #26 manual review (Jim + codex, issuecomment-5174184754): nine follow-up items, all verified accurate and valid. Plan approved by Jim in chat: five bundles on the epic branch before merge — A lifecycle integrity (correction/retraction event honored by derivation; failed sweeps do not advance the stage word; archival gates on a COMPLETE release event), B childless-epic derivation (derive from the epic item's own status), C migration contract REVISED BY JIM: candidates = every top-level item except dropped (live AND done — done features derive built; excluding them contradicted the grill's built/in-flight/planned goal and would leave migrated products historyless, e.g. speed-count), judgment unchanged, optional hand-charted pre-history step, bounded validate audit (selection event <-> nodes), in-nahel failure/redo semantics so recovery never needs git, D map durability+concurrency (Decisions-so-far DERIVED from resolved tickets — kills the shared-array hot spot; rationale into the resolve observation; closed tickets leave a durable trace), E standup memory streaming. Design consult with codex first on A/C/D (A revisits the open-extension ruling with new archival-gating facts). All red-first, codex per bundle + final epic gate, PR #26 re-parked.
